decisions.statement: Deliver all named subsystems in one resumable phase with internal slices.
decisions.rationale: The owner selected full-scope delivery rather than a foundation-only phase.

decisions.statement: Git closeout is prepared automatically but commit, push, main update, branch deletion, and worktree removal require exact owner approval.
decisions.rationale: Preserves explicit irreversible authority.

decisions.statement: Safely install pinned official user-space apps/providers automatically; fall back to an official link when elevation or manual action is required.
decisions.rationale: The owner requested automatic setup without repeated prompts.

decisions.statement: Selected external skills are installed completely across every detected host; candidates that are not selected remain source links only.
decisions.rationale: Avoids host drift without blindly cloning every repository.

decisions.statement: Test every claim pragmatically and prefer real UI/device business behavior over deep ceremonial scripts.
decisions.rationale: The owner prioritizes catching real behavior failures with bounded verification time.

decisions.statement: OpenCode currently supports custom slash commands but not Codex-native durable goals.
decisions.rationale: Implement /goal as an explicit compatibility bridge and attest it as emulated.

decisions.statement: Keep SKILL.md portable and ROUTE.json as the harness routing sidecar.
decisions.rationale: Matches the repository schema and avoids unnecessary route.yaml migration.

decisions.statement: MCP is a replaceable provider edge; optional MCP Tasks cannot become kernel authority.
decisions.rationale: Host support is negotiated and non-universal.

decisions.statement: Unknown hosts return UNSUPPORTED; only registered adapters can receive parity verdicts.
decisions.rationale: Provider-neutral architecture does not imply zero-code support for arbitrary hosts.

decisions.statement: Use the detached Pencil commits as a proven migration candidate, not as automatic final truth.
decisions.rationale: Their focused build and tests pass, but host materialization remains incomplete.

decisions.statement: Do not activate the new current pointer while only preparing support artifacts.
decisions.rationale: Existing V3.1 gates are pointer-hard-coded; S1/S7 must add generic compatibility before S8 CAS activation.

decisions.statement: Preserve unrelated untracked Control Plane support files and user work.
decisions.rationale: They are outside this phase's owned scope.

decisions.statement: Repair attempts are capped at two per claim.
decisions.rationale: Prevents infinite convergence loops and preserves honest blockers.

decisions.statement: Maximum worker delegation is two with no recursion and disjoint writes.
decisions.rationale: Matches repository invariants and limits coordination entropy.

decisions.statement: Closed-loop behavior must be represented by typed runtime contracts and evidence, not prose-only instructions.
decisions.rationale: Mechanical reconciliation requires machine-checkable sensors, transitions, clamps, and terminal states.

decisions.statement: Semantic workflow validation covers the high-impact rule and skill graph in addition to full-catalog structural validation.
decisions.rationale: Existing validators can pass while lifecycle, delegation, routing, and UI precedence still contradict one another.

decisions.statement: Model-specific workarounds require owner, trigger, expiry, retirement evidence, and bounded blast radius.
decisions.rationale: Prevents temporary compatibility fixes from becoming permanent policy debt.

decisions.statement: OpenCode /goal is generated as a host-native custom command by S1 and remains explicitly attested as emulated; the bootstrap prompt is used before installation or reload.
decisions.rationale: OpenCode supports custom commands but does not provide Codex-native durable goals.

decisions.statement: The Control Plane redesign remains a successor phase after this patch, beginning with visible Pencil MCP design and owner approval, then a full frontend rebuild, Docker Compose packaging, and foreground browser verification.
decisions.rationale: Preserves scope and lets the redesigned UI consume stable runtime contracts rather than moving targets.

decisions.statement: Control Plane V2 is the final phase and remains ineligible until all selected skills and every provider/tool/MCP/rule/command/host/runtime projection are complete, installed, reconciled, verified, CI-green, and the harness closeout is owner-approved.
decisions.rationale: The owner requires the UI phase to consume the fully finished harness rather than begin after only a partial patch.

decisions.statement: Ordinary conversation is the primary portable entrypoint; /goal and every host-native launcher are optional ergonomic adapters that compile to the same WorkRequest and own no plan semantics or authority.
decisions.rationale: Mandatory host-specific goal mechanisms can drift lifecycle and context across platforms.

decisions.statement: A post-plan user finding opens conversational pair repair that selectively reopens impacted claims and candidate-bound evidence rather than restarting the whole plan or preserving a stale PASS.
decisions.rationale: Owner verification must remain first-class without discarding unaffected proof or forcing ceremony.
